description: This PHP source file defines the class TestRunCommands which extends Robo	asks and provides command methods for running various test suites (install, API, acceptance, unit) with customizable options such as debug output and fail-fast. It is part of the SuiteCRM project and uses Symfony Console InputOption and traits for Robo commands.

classes.name: TestRunCommands
classes.description: Defines CLI commands to run various test suites (install, API, acceptance, unit) with options for debugging and failing fast, using Robo tasks.

methods.name: TestsInstall
methods.description: Runs the install test suite via Codeception with options for debug and fail-fast.

methods.name: TestsAPI
methods.description: Runs the API test suite via Codeception with options for debug and fail-fast.

methods.name: TestsAcceptance
methods.description: Runs the acceptance test suite via Codeception with options for debug and fail-fast.

methods.name: TestsUnit
methods.description: Runs the PHPUnit unit test suite with options for debug, fail-fast, and test filtering.
